installPath.notAbsolute: The installation path must be an absolute path (for example a folder on a local drive).
installPath.filesystemRoot: Cannot install to a drive root. Choose a folder inside the drive.
installPath.pathNotDirectory: The selected path exists but is not a folder.
installPath.directoryMustBeEmptyOrModforge: The installation folder must be empty, or already contain a ModForge Studio installation.
installPath.inspectDirectoryFailed: Could not read the installation folder. Check permissions and try again.
installPath.directoryNotWritable: The installation folder is not writable. Choose another location or run the installer as administrator (see below).
installPath.parentNotWritable: The parent folder is not writable. System folders such as Program Files often require administrator rights (see below).
installPath.adminHint: To install under protected locations (for example Program Files), close this installer, right-click the installer executable, choose "Run as administrator", then try again. Alternatively install under your user profile, for example %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs, which does not require elevation.

options.title: Options
options.subtitle: Review install location and preferences
options.autoStart: Launch ModForge Studio on system startup
options.existingInstallBinaryMissing: The main application file was not found at that location. You can run the uninstaller first or reinstall.
options.existingInstallHint: Click Install to upgrade or repair in place. To uninstall first, run the registered uninstaller below.

uninstall.title: Uninstall ModForge Studio
uninstall.subtitle: This removes ModForge Studio and its integrations (shortcuts, registry entries).
uninstall.deleteData: Also delete user data (settings, workspace state, cache)
uninstall.deleteDataHint: Only the %APPDATA%\ModForge Studio folder is removed. Mods, game folders and your documents are never touched.
uninstall.completed: Uninstall completed. You can close this window.

preferences.title: App Preferences
preferences.subtitle: Pre-select the theme, motion style and default behavior for ModForge Studio. They are written to the app's settings file before installation.

quit.label: Quit the app
quit.description: Closing the window exits ModForge Studio.

minimizeToTray.label: Minimize to tray
minimizeToTray.description: Closing the window keeps ModForge Studio running in the system tray.
